title: helleborine latifolia subvar. leptochila
intro: Helleborine latifolia subvar. leptochila, commonly known as the green helleborine, is a plant species within the orchid family, Epipogioideae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing respiratory issues. The health benefits of the green helleborine include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of the green helleborine include flavonoids and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties.
